description: Symmetric N-player risk-preference persona: all 3 seats at Eckel-Grossman gamble 1 of 6 (paper SI Task 1, arXiv-2607.26034v1). Symmetric-only because the full per-seat combinatorial matrix (6^N) is intractable for N > 2 -- see ai_race/engine_nplayer/README.md.
